param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$Target,
    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$IdentityFile,
    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$Archive,
    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$Manifest,
    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$PublicKey
)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Set-StrictMode -Version Latest

if (-not (Test-Path $IdentityFile) -or -not (Test-Path $Archive) -or -not (Test-Path $Manifest) -or -not (Test-Path $PublicKey)) {
    throw 'SSH key and signed bundle inputs must exist outside version control'
}
$parts = $Target.Split('@', 2)
if ($parts.Count -ne 2) { throw 'Target must be user@host' }
$repo = (Resolve-Path (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..')).Path
$arguments = @(
    'install', '--user', $parts[0], '--host', $parts[1], '--identity', (Resolve-Path $IdentityFile).Path,
    '--manifest', (Resolve-Path $Manifest).Path, '--archive', (Resolve-Path $Archive).Path,
    '--public-key', (Resolve-Path $PublicKey).Path
)
& (Join-Path $repo 'gradlew.bat') ':ji-remote-bootstrap:run' '--offline' '--args' ($arguments -join ' ')
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Remote Host clean-account verification failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE" }
Write-Output 'STAGE4_REMOTE_INSTALL_OK'
